lines.2: 「All right. Time to head to the student council.」
lines.3: 「Tsushima, you work very seriously lately. Very good.」
lines.4: 「Well, you know. Is how it goes.」
lines.5: 「Next time, our cooking club bring food to student council. Make sure you eat some too.」
lines.6: 「Really? The cooking club is going to all that trouble?」
lines.7: 「Many people in our club favor Kurogane. Some favor Princess too.」
lines.9: Otome and the Princess were both wildly popular with the female students.
lines.10: Otome was more dashing than most men, after all.
lines.14: It wasn't actually hot, but there was something intense in the air.
